verdicts.quote: The oldest eligible waiter is booked the moment a spot frees; no accept/decline step and no timer.
each entry takes the next value of a per-class counter, assigned inside the join transaction. Order is ascending sequence. … promotion always takes the lowest eligible sequence.
joining several overlapping classes' waitlists (no clash check is added)
verdicts.missing: The spec addresses joining both lists but leaves the fate of the other entry when one promotion succeeds unspecified.

verdicts.quote: claim window / accept-decline offers (A-1); manual staff promotion; swapping places; promoting a party of several members together; refunds or penalties.
verdicts.missing: There is no offer to decline. Whether missing or cancelling an automatically booked spot incurs the existing no-show or late-cancellation penalty is unspecified.

verdicts.quote: actor (member or staff) → existing cancel/remove/capacity operation → same atomic unit runs T-3/T-4 loop → committed → affected members see results on next read
Outbound notification of promotion and removal uses an existing channel if one exists (AD-7, G-4). … a failed notification send never reverses a promotion; it is logged (R-12).
verdicts.missing: The in-app booking label is specified, but the outbound channel is unresolved and the required contents of the outbound message are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: all operations on one class serialize (AD-1). … marks it `Promoted`, and repeats until the class is full again or no `Waiting` entry remains.

A member who already has a `Waiting` entry directly booking → `ALREADY_WAITLISTED`. … all operations on one class serialize (AD-1). … the cancellation promotes in its own unit, and the direct booking sees the class full.
whether automatic promotion may do that on the member's behalf needs an owner decision … Interim: those classes are excluded from the waitlist (R-1 open gap).
verdicts.missing: Paid classes are excluded for now. If enabled, when to charge or consume credit and what happens to the entry and spot on payment failure are undecided.

verdicts.quote: There is no length cap: the Nth member (N unbounded, ≤ distinct members) is accepted exactly like the first.
an operation timestamped one tick before B turns false promotes; one tick after does not. … The real B(class, now) (cut-off rules) and booking eligibility rules
verdicts.missing: The spec uses the existing booking cut-off but leaves open whether and how far before class start it occurs.

verdicts.quote: A capacity increase of *k* promotes up to *k* entries. … booked count ≤ capacity, except where staff lower capacity below the booked count (existing behaviour, untouched).
Waitlist entry (class, member, sequence, status, reason) … Position, waiting count | derived at read | the member | not stored
verdicts.missing: The sequence records join order, but the entry has no stated join timestamp.

verdicts.quote: `Waiting` entries become `Removed(WAITLIST_CLOSED)` as soon as B(class, now) is false … while the class record exists, and shown to the member until the class's start time passes.
a member sees only their own entries, their position and the anonymous waiting count — never another member's name, id or entry.
Staff visibility of waiters is out of scope. … manual staff promotion … the sink holds one `waitlist.promoted` for C-100 with an opaque member id and no personal fields.
verdicts.missing: The spec excludes staff viewing and manual promotion, and supplies no staff action to remove a waiter or staff-accessible history showing who was promoted at what time.

verdicts.quote: promotion runs inside the transaction of the operation that freed capacity.

classes that are not full, booking, cancelling a booking, capacity enforcement and the existing cut-off rules behave as before, except that cancelling/removal/capacity-increase on a class with waiters also promotes (R-3).
